Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ready? One, two, three!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (looking through binoculars) And off she goes! Baljeet, cue the live feed.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: The ball should arrive at Mount Kilimanjaro in roughly 11 minutes.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Cool! The first-ever game of lacrosse-country.

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's kinda weird that we're doin' it at night.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, that's just because it'll be morning in Africa when it lands. I just hope Ferb makes it back in time to see it happen.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What is Ferb doing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I dunno. He didn't say.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What should we do while we wait?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hmmm.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (gasps)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Do not even think about suggesting the Bread Bowl Hot Tub again!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Too late! Already thunk!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What about regular-sized lacrosse, but rocket-powered?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great idea, Isabella! Perry can be the ref. Hey, where is Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Apologies, Agent P, and, ih, sorry for calling you in after hours. Fish have been mysteriously disappearing all over Danville. Smells like Doofenshmirtz to me. Ya know, 'cause he often smells a lot like fish.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Mackerel, specifically.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Get back on that camera, Carl! (scoffs) Interns these days. What're we even not paying them for? Unfortunately, we're running low on budget, because we spent most of our money making new entrances for your lair. Get to Doofenshmirtz's quickly before your overtime kicks in.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: He always forgets to turn off the lights! I'll just get it with the remote.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Why do we even have a dance party setting?!

Name: Carl
Dialog: (boogieing) Worth every penny, sir!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, that's it for me, Carl. The season premiere of Workplace Acquaintances is tonight, and I hear the episode is really tepid.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh, I've gotta get to my part-time job! I'm late for work!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: This is your job, Carl. Everything else is a hobby.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Heh. Youths these days.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Right this way, please.

Name: Chef
Dialog: No lobster! This is turf and turf night! We've got a food critic out there!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (on Carl's watch) Carl, where are you?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (whispering) I'm at work, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (sarcastically) Sure you are. Agent P still hasn't finished his mission and our trackers show he's in your area.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Wait, how would you know Agent P is near me unless you have a tracker in me, too?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Never mind that, Carl. His overtime is expensive, and, you, on the other hand, are free. So stop goofing off, find Doof, and help Agent P finish up fast.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (laughs)

Name: Carl
Dialog: I think I found him, sir.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thanks for taking time out of your evening to thwart me, Perry the Platypus. You know the old saying, "Give a man a fish, he eats for a day. Give a man a fish-inator, and he can rule the entire Tri-State Area!" Order's up!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm still working on a real evil application for this, but, for now, I'll settle for serving people live fish without consent. That's a little evil. Toodles!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Agent P, let me help you with that.

Name: Diner 1
Dialog: Is this sushi grade?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I can handle things here, Agent P. You go after Doofenshmirtz!

Name: Chef
Dialog: Brilliant work, Carl! You truly are the cream of the corn.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh, thanks, boss.

Name: Chef
Dialog: Now, check in on that critic for me, won't you?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Uh, excuse me. Can I ask how the review is going?

Name: Diner 2
Dialog: Oh, I'm not a food critic. I'm just working on my screenplay.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Well, do you have any notes on the food?

Name: Diner 2
Dialog: The appetizer felt unmotivated.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (looks at his watch) Oh, weasel-toes! I've gotta get into costume and get to my next job!

Name: Chef
Dialog: Good luck, Carl! Hmmm, well, if he's not the food critic, who is? Mmmm...

Name: Waiter
Dialog: How was the meal, sir?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: The turf was excellent, but the turf left a bit to be desired.

Name: Carl
Dialog: What is it now, sir?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, Agent P isn't done and you're literally clowning around!

Name: Carl
Dialog: But, sir, I'm at work.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You mean, "hobby". Go help him.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (gasps)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha ha! A birthday party! Perfect. This is next on the list of things I can ruin! With fish!

Name: Robert
Dialog: I wish this was a gift card.

Name: Brittany
Dialog: I don't!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Keep after Doof, Agent P. I'll fix things here.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (to Robert) Now blow out your candles and make a wish!

Name: Robert
Dialog: I wish for this experience not to traumatize me for life!

Name: Brittany
Dialog: I don't.

Name: Guy in Ducky Momo costume
Dialog: Nice save, man. You doin' okay?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yeah. Thanks. I just have to get to my next job.

Name: Guy in Ducky Momo costume
Dialog: I have an engineering degree.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Huh. Usually, some unforeseen element would have removed our invention by now. Perhaps we should take it down.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm sure nature will find a way.

Name: Pizza Manager
Dialog: You're just in time, delivery boy dude. I got a fresh one going out. This one's priority, pal. It's perplexing how impatient patrons are for a pizza pie with their profile pic upon it. (chuckles) Alliteration. (seriously) Don't be late. Remember, customer retention is way more important than employee mental health.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oi.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, what are you doing?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I already told you, I'm at work!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: No excuses. Agent P is going into triple overtime and OWCA will be bankrupt.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, I really shouldn't be—

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, commercial's over. My show's about to start. Just get to it, Carl. (hangs up)

Name: Carl
Dialog: (sighs, then leaves)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So I figured it all out. A fish in the hand is worth two in the inator, but a fish in everyone's hands means they can't stop me from taking over the entire Tri-State Area! (laughs) Because their hands are full. Of fish!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Go get him, Agent P! And I've got a pizza to deliver!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (laughs)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (grunts) Ow! Oh, so that's how you wanna do this, huh? Let's see how you karate chop with your hands full of fish!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Huh? Okay. Time to fight fish with fish. Y'know, like surf and surf.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aah! Aah! Aah!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (yawns, groggy) What are you doing? It's so late.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes. Yes, it is.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, if it's still here in the morning, I'm gonna bust you guys. (yawns) Your'e goin' down, down, down. (goes back to bed)

Name: Buford
Dialog: See? Nature always finds a way.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: We are not fish-leaping distance within any body of water. How is that nature?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, so you give a platypus a fish and he clogs your inator.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, wh— Where did all the fish go?

Name: Farmer's Wife
Dialog: I can't believe you opened an aquarium but forgot to buy any fish!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And there they are. Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sorry for the delay.

Name: Customer
Dialog: It's been over thirty minutes. That means my pizza is free—

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Wait, Carl? Is that you?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Major Monogram?!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (tries to grab the pizza box) Well, Carl, if you hadn't wasted your evening with all your silly antics, maybe you'd be able to deliver a pizza on time.

Name: Carl
Dialog: "Silly antics"? I've told you three times now! Those are my part-time jobs!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, I thought you were joking about that. But, you know, seeing you in uniform and handing me a pizza, I admit I might be mistaken.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, I'm an unpaid intern! How d'you think I afford to pay rent?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: With experience and exposure?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I even have to pay for my own parking at OWCA! This internship is actually costing me money! (He sits down and leans against the wall.) I love this job, but if I keep having to work like this, even in my off-hours, I—

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You know, Carl, I see firsthand just how much you do for OWCA. And although it goes without saying, I'm going to say it. You are one of the hardest workers I know. You're not just an intern. (offers his hand) You're more than an intern.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Thanks, sir. That means a lot.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: In fact, ih, why don't you come on in and enjoy a slice on me? And I've even got a special surprise for you. (gets out his wallet) You're getting paid!

Name: Carl
Dialog: I'm... I'm being promoted to paid intern?!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (hands out money) No! For the delivery. Even though it was 37 seconds late. But I will be sure to validate your parking. Heh. A "paid intern". That would be preposterous.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Wow! I think my career just took a giant step forward.

Name: Brittany
Dialog: I don't.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Can it, Brittany.

Name: Farmer
Dialog: Finally. Honey!

Name: Farmer's Wife
Dialog: I'll see it in the morning!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Then you seriously underestimated us.
